excerpt.zh: 近期的[this.GetAffectedStormType]对[this.GetName]的气候产生了意想不到的影响。
excerpt.en: The recent [this.GetAffectedStormType] has had an unexpected impact on the climate of [this.GetName].

texts.zh: 近期的[this.GetAffectedStormType]对[this.GetName]的气候产生了意想不到的影响。
texts.en: The recent [this.GetAffectedStormType] has had an unexpected impact on the climate of [this.GetName].

texts.zh:
大气中积聚的电荷导致了两极地区的剧烈温度变化。让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
texts.en:
The increased electrical charge in the atmosphere has led to a drastic temperature shift in the polar region, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

texts.en:
